## Overview

The RavenDB override of Birko.Data.EventSourcing's default event store ([[TASK-995]]). It is the default
`AsyncStoreEventStore` over the RavenDB store of `EventRecord`, except that a batch is written in one session, so it is
stored whole or not at all, even if the process dies partway. Obtained without naming the backend:
`factory.GetEventStore(o => o.AddRavenDB())`.

## Dependencies

- Birko.Data.EventSourcing (AsyncStoreEventStore, EventRecord, EventStoreOverrides)
- Birko.Data.RavenDB (AsyncRavenDBStore, RavenDBStoreFactory)
- NuGet: RavenDB.Client (through Birko.Data.RavenDB)

## Key Design Decisions

**Why an override exists.** The default passes the contract on RavenDB. But it writes one event at a time and deletes its
own events when a later one conflicts, so a crash in between leaves part of a batch stored (TASK-995, decision 4). RavenDB's
bulk create saves the whole batch in one `SaveChanges`, one server transaction: a batch with a taken id in the middle
stored nothing (measured, TASK-995). The user's decision 4 is to use native atomicity where the backend has it.

**Conflicts.** RavenDB refuses a taken id, because the create runs with an empty change vector
(`StoreUniqueViolationException`). It does not say which document collided, so `FindConflictAsync` looks it up afterwards.
A version twice in one batch is named before any round trip.

## Gotchas

- Collection `EventRecords`, document id = the record's name-based Guid. Database creation is safe when several clients
  start together ([[TASK-996]]).
- Reads are index queries, so they wait for non-stale results, as every Birko RavenDB read does (`RavenIndexWait`).
- Tests: `tests/Birko.Data.EventSourcing.RavenDB.Tests`, the shared contract, live under `BIRKO_RAVEN_URL`.
